audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer gave Pantheon all seven level-chart rows and labelled the lane HARD 8/10, while the content layer's win[0..6], every content why, and the packet levelChart all say Xerath — over 2056 games at 54.86%.
audit.why: Pantheon's longest reach into Xerath is Shield Vault at 600 units (Comet Spear is 575); a charged Arcanopulse fires from well beyond both, and Aegis Assault is on 22/21/20/19/18s so it cannot cover repeated poke. The page's own prose ('lopsidedly yours all game') already argued Xerath.
audit.corrected: phases[0..6].side moved to Xerath to agree with win[0..6]; diff, tone, diffRating and the difficulty strings brought in line with the 54.86% win rate.

audit.why: Lost Chapter, level 6 and Luden's are your spikes. Pantheon's are levels 1-3 and Grand Starfall at 180/165/150s for map pressure, not lane pressure; he falls off as your items land.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four decisive interactions from the missing-interactions file never appeared anywhere on the page: Aegis Assault is a channel your Shocking Orb cancels; it only blocks frontally; Shield Vault cancels your Rite of the Arcane mid-channel; and Shield Vault opens with an auto-attack reset whose wind-up is the real tell.
audit.why: Aegis Assault (E) carries channel + untargetable + shield flags and Riot's own text says invulnerable from the front only. Shield Vault (W) carries dash + hardCC + autoReset and is 13/12/11/10/9s. Your R is flagged channel: interruptible — any CC cancels it, so channelling while W is up gives him a free 100-mana steal.
audit.corrected: All four written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[1], dontsFull[2], enemyWin and content spikes[1].text with the real cooldowns.

audit.why: Shield Vault is 13s at rank 1 and Aegis Assault 22s at rank 1 — those two numbers are the entire step-up schedule of this lane.
audit.corrected: Both written in with the R-channel warning attached.

audit.why: Packet flagged 'His Aegis Assault' in early as a probable wrong name. Aegis Assault is Pantheon's real E — a false positive.

edits.before: Rite of the Arcane (R) is a global execute-style threat, but in lane its value is punishing Pantheon after he blows Aegis Assault (E); if he E-shields your poke, wait it out and re-poke, since his all-in is toothless once he's low.
edits.after: Rite of the Arcane (R) punishes Pantheon after the 22-second Aegis Assault (E) — it blocks frontally only, so an off-angle Shocking Orb cancels the channel outright. Never start your R while Shield Vault is up; it interrupts you and eats the 100 mana.

notes: Largest defect here was the level chart: the full layer read Pantheon on all seven rows while content win[0..6] and the packet both read Xerath, and the full layer also carried HARD 8/10 against a 54.86% Xerath win rate over 2056 games. Sides flipped to Xerath (no paired win[N] edits — the content layer was already correct, so those would have been no-ops), and diff/tone/diffRating/difficulty strings brought into line. carryRating left at 8.5/10: Pantheon is still a high-threat snowballer even in a lane he loses, and nothing in the kits justified moving it. The four missing interactions (channel cancel, frontal-only block, W interrupting your R, autoreset tell) are all now on the page. Packet suspectName 'His Aegis Assault' is a false positive.
